biggest_catch: It's $50 of stock slices, not $50 cash — Schwab automatically invests the bonus in fractional shares of the 5 largest S&P 500 stocks, and you must first deposit $50 of your own money within 30 days of opening. Net: you put in $50 of your own cash and end up with about $100 invested, not $50 you can spend.
catches: You must enroll through the Schwab Starter Kit offer page — opening a regular Schwab account any other way does not qualify.
The $50 arrives as fractional shares (Schwab Stock Slices) of the top 5 S&P 500 stocks by market cap, split equally — it is not withdrawable cash.
You must deposit at least $50 of your own (outside) money into the new Schwab One individual taxable brokerage account within 30 days of opening/enrolling.
New Schwab customers only — individuals with no existing Charles Schwab & Co. account (other than a Schwab Stock Plan Services account).
The top-5 stocks change over time; your slices are the top 5 by market cap on the date the orders are placed.

Schwab's separate referral promo pays more ($100/$300/$500/$1,000 at $25k/$50k/$100k/$500k net deposits within 45 days) but requires a referral code from an existing Schwab client — it is not available to walk-up new clients.

steps: Go to the official Schwab Starter Kit page https://www.schwab.com/investing-starter-kit and click through to open the account — this enrolls you in the offer (opening a regular Schwab account elsewhere does not qualify).
Complete the application for a Schwab One individual taxable brokerage account (about 10 minutes) and get approved.
Within 30 days of opening, deposit at least $50 of your own money from an outside source into the new account.

Once funded, Schwab deposits $50 into your account and uses it to buy fractional shares (Stock Slices) of the top 5 S&P 500 stocks by market cap, split equally — you'll be notified when the orders are placed.
The $50 of stock slices is yours to keep invested; it is not cash you can withdraw and spend.
timing: Bonus deposited once the account is funded; Schwab notifies you when the fractional-share orders are placed.
